title: How to Make a Children's Cartoon Show With AI
summary: How to make a cartoon show for kids with AI: a small world, recurring characters, a repeatable format, gentle pacing and voices, shown with real Flick clips.
body_markdown:
### How do you make a cartoon series with AI?


Design the characters and places once as reference images, write a story shape you can repeat, then generate each episode shot by shot from those same references. Keep them on one canvas, so the next episode starts from the characters you already have.


### How do you make an animated show on your own?


Keep it small: two characters, a few places and short episodes. One person can write, generate and cut a short cartoon with AI, as Katrin Ann Orbeta is credited for the character design, AI prompting and editing of Mila & Sasa, with an associate producer.


### How do you keep cartoon characters consistent across episodes?


Make a sheet for each character with several views and expressions, then cite the sheet in each shot's prompt and describe the outfit the same way each time. Reuse the same voice line as a reference, so the character sounds the same too.


### How long should an episode of a kids' cartoon be?


Preschool cartoons often run about 5 to 11 minutes, and Bluey is listed at about 7 minutes on Wikipedia. For a first AI episode, a shorter target of a few minutes is more realistic, since each minute needs many separate shots.


### Can I make a show in the style of a famous cartoon?


Make your own characters and your own look instead. A famous show's characters and designs usually belong to its owner, and copying them can get a video taken down. Describe qualities such as flat shapes and pastel colors. This is general guidance, not legal advice.


### Can I post an AI cartoon for kids on YouTube?


Yes, but check the rules first. YouTube asks creators to say whether a video is made for kids, which changes how it can be shown, and it has rules on disclosing some AI content. Read its current policies before you publish a series.


### What voices work best for a children's cartoon?


Calm, clear voices with short sentences, so a young viewer can follow each word. Give each character a voice that sounds different from the other, and test the lines by reading them aloud before you generate them.


### Can I make a children's cartoon show for free?


You can start for free in Flick, with no credit card, and make characters and backgrounds with Nano Banana 2 on free credits. Video models such as MiniMax H3 and Seedance 2.0 need the Standard plan or higher.
